what: batch-yield: a patch-leaving rule for `drishyam batch` (JobConfig.next_ev, `--batch-yield`, off by default). Under budget pressure a photo's job ends once its best next look (a best-score look, after at least one look of this photo) is worth less than the next queued photo's first look. Forced looks (survey, the rules' follow-ups, confirm, fallback, replay) are never cut. A job it ends has cause batch-yield and is halted: every candidate it did not look at is listed as not assessed, never as clean. Candidates it skips are not revisited.
motivation: A three-judge re-grade of v1.1.1 scored Agentic orchestration and autonomy lowest (6.0/10, weight 25): the batch fixes its plan at triage and never changes it from what its own jobs measure. Every job runs to its own stop rule or its 20 s cap whatever the rest of the backlog offers; on the 2,536-photo backlog 1,949 photos ended not assessed.
prior_art: Charnov, E. L. (1976). Optimal foraging, the marginal value theorem. Theoretical Population Biology 9(2): 129-136. A forager leaves a patch when the marginal gain of staying falls to what moving on offers.
design: A look's value is `Job._score`'s expected value before dividing by t_hat: prior x severity x (1 + uncertainty) x unseen; every best-score step record now carries it as `value`. next_ev is the next queued photo's triage prior_max: its first look's value with severity 1, entropy 0 and unseen 1 (under v1-policy2 the regions are grid tiles whose prior is their best candidate's, so the best tile's prior is the photo's prior_max: tests/test_agent.py). run_batch sets it only under budget pressure: the seconds left are fewer than the photos left (this one included) x the mean seconds of the jobs run so far (before the first job has run: off); otherwise, and for the last photo, next_ev is 0. Each `started` line of batch_trace.jsonl logs next_ev. At next_ev 0 every decision is the agent's as before (tests/test_agent.py: whole event streams equal the agent with the rule's lines removed, apart from `value`).
rule: Stated before any run (committed with this file, before any output of evals/batch_yield.py exists; the run records this file's commit and its own start time). Backlog: the 190 dev photos of evals/router_eval.py (synth_dev 60, the first 30 of synth_clean_dev, CODEBRIM dev100), in its seeded shuffle (seed 0). Agent: v1 (onnx:drishyam_dacl10k.onnx, its FP16 net as the fast model) at its profile with v1-policy2, on the fixed costs of results/local-macos-x86-dacl10k-retime/micro.json on a virtual clock, default per-photo caps (pixel 0.30, $0.05, 20 s), governor on, thumbnails off, as router_eval ran it. Each photo's job runs once in full; every arm and budget is replayed exactly from those runs (a job given a seconds cap or a next_ev takes the same looks up to its halt), each truncated job credited with the work order it would leave: its critical findings as they stood after its last look. A real run_batch(batch_yield=True) on the first 24 photos at half their full seconds checks the replay. Arms: (a) rule triage as published: drishyam batch --router rule's order (highest prior sum first, ties in file order), triage seconds charged, no batch-yield; (b) the same order and charge with batch-yield; (c) random order: mean of 1000 seeded permutations (100 per bootstrap resample), no triage charged, no batch-yield. Primary metric: critical recall within budget, the share of the backlog's labelled critical defects (evals.harness.gt_critical) that a critical finding of the same class hits (evals.harness.hits: IoU >= 0.3 or containing its centre) before the batch budget runs out, at a total budget of half the seconds the 190 jobs take run in full. Verdict: Gain if the paired 95 % bootstrap CI (1000 resamples of the photos within each of the three splits, seed 0; each resample's budget the same share of its own full seconds) of (b) / (a) lies above 1; Harm if it lies below 1; otherwise no measurable difference. Adoption: batch-yield becomes the default of drishyam batch only on a Gain with no more false critical findings on the clean split than arm (a) at the primary budget (critical findings queued on synth_clean_dev photos: every one is false). Otherwise the result is published and the knob stays off. Run once: the script refuses to run when this file already holds a verdict or differs from its commit.
reported_not_in_rule: the quarter and three-quarter budgets, with the same paired CIs
photos reached; not-assessed entries in the batch report (photos not reached, plus each work order's list); batch-yield halts
false critical findings (critical findings that hit no labelled critical defect of their class), and those on the clean split
critical findings queued per photo reached
time to the first queued critical defect (censored at the budget)
triage against random order under v1, with a paired CI: computed after the router run (results/dev/router_eval.json reported no such CI under v1)

identity: the 190 full runs against router_eval.json's published per-photo seconds and full-run queued defects, and its triage arm replayed with the published credit (batch_triage.replay: final boxes)
next_ev as a proxy: the first best-score look's value over the photo's triage prior_max (v1 runs the survey first, which seeds entropy and class)
descriptive_only: Then, not part of the rule: drishyam batch data/backlog_2536/backlog.txt --router rule --cost-model fixed --micro-arm local-macos-x86-dacl10k-retime --usd-cap 0.50, with and without --batch-yield, reporting photos not assessed and critical findings queued; skipped if it would take over 90 minutes.
known_limit: Candidates a yield defers are not revisited. A second pass is added only if the dev run shows budget left over, and only after the rule is read, as a separate, labelled follow-up.
